question_answered: Where to show 'for this plant/hub and 5min horizon, what technique are we using?' and how to show simulation at grid/hub/block levels.

technique_location: Plant Brief: Forecast Configuration mini-section for selected plant/hub/block.
Historical Lab: Validation results and evidence for that technique.
Live Operating Day: Active technique card updates when level/horizon changes.
Online Learning: Shows how that technique is adapting during replay.
short_answer.simulation_level: The current simulation is mostly aggregate/representative. Add a level selector: Grid / Plant / Hub / Block.

implementation_steps: Add selector: Level = Grid / Plant / Hub / Block.
Add selector: Asset ID filtered by level.
On every change, find row where asset_level + asset_id + horizon match.
Render Technique Card with business_name, technique_short, technique_full, inputs, metrics and plain_language_explanation.
Use simulation_level_config.json to aggregate or filter simulation data by selected level.
For grid/plant/hub aggregate views, show contribution breakdown by child assets.
For block view, show direct SCADA/sensor diagnostics.
acceptance_tests: Selecting Hub 3 + 5min shows persistence + ramp-rate correction and explains cloud ramp watch.
Selecting Hub 6 + 2hour shows physical weather-to-power + Gaussian residual and shows curtailment/local limit as input.
Selecting Grid + 40hour shows NWP ensemble weather-to-power + quantile calibration.
Switching from Plant to Hub changes chart values and technique explanation.
Block level simulation displays one block only and shows inverter/sensor details.
